from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class MonthlyObservation(BaseModel):
    """One monthly data point extracted from a single report."""
    reporting_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data refers to (YYYY-MM)")
    release_date: str | None = Field(description="The release date of the report (YYYY-MM)")
    value: float | None = Field(description="Number of housing units authorized (in thousands)")
    adjustment_status: str | None = Field(description="Seasonal adjustment status of the data")
    unit_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of units reported (e.g., 'Total', 'Privately-Owned')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    observations: list[MonthlyObservation]
